hero.paragraph: Discover new books with a swipe, organise your reading, find where to get the titles you choose and talk them over with other readers.

match.label: Discover with the match
match.title: Your next book, one swipe at a time.
match.text: Bookrelay's suggestions start from the genres you like, the books you've loved and your reading goals.
match.text2: Browse the titles, dig into the ones that catch your eye and find out why we're suggesting them.

libreria.label: Your library
libreria.title: All your reading, in one place.
libreria.text: Collect the books you want to read, the ones you've started and the ones you've finished. Organise your titles and find them easily in your Library.

reperimento.label: Finding it
reperimento.title: You've picked the book. Find out where to get it.
reperimento.text: For every title, see the ways to get hold of it: buy it new or used, or look for it in bookshops and libraries, when available.
reperimento.text2: Choose the option that suits you and go from discovery to reading.

community.label: The community
community.title: A book in common. Every read is richer when you can share it.
community.text: Find readers who are reading the same title or share your interests.
community.text2: Join discussions, share impressions and points of view, and create reading groups around a book or a topic. For one-to-one conversations, you can also chat with other readers.

hub.title: Take your reading off the screen
hub.text: We're working on a map of Bookrelay Hubs: local spaces and meeting points where readers can get together, talk about books, join reading groups and swap books.
hub.text2: Places where conversations started online can continue in person, sparking new friendships and new chances to share books.

partner.title: Want to become a Bookrelay Hub?
partner.text: We're designing a dashboard for the spaces that join the network. It will let you present your venue, promote events and initiatives, create reading groups and bring readers together to meet and swap books.
partner.text2: Get in touch to learn about the project and register your interest.

waitlist.paragraph: Find your next book, organise your reading and share impressions and ideas with other readers.

form.successText: We'll write to you as soon as the app is ready for early access.
form.title: Join the Bookrelay community
form.description: We're opening access to a limited number of readers who want to discover and test the platform before the official launch. Sign up today to receive your invite and follow the project's progress closely. Early sign-ups will get early access to new features.
form.errorDuplicate: This email is already on the waitlist!
form.errorGeneric: Something went wrong. Please try again later.
